$comment: Aircraft landing gear library. See data/SOURCES.md for source methods and limitations.
737 and 777 entries derive main-gear track from FAA outer tire width: track = outerWidth - (wheelsAcross - 1) * dualSpacing - tireSectionWidth.
FAA outer width is not a wheel-center track. Do not use the two interchangeably.
747, A380, reviewed Aircrafter entries, and the 757/767 additions use manufacturer footprint geometry directly.
The 757/767 drawings explicitly dimension wheelbase, track, nose pitch, main dual pitch, and tandem pitch. Exact imperial-to-mm conversions supersede the old rounded FAA geometry.
MTOW, taxi weight, tires and pressure refer to the individually documented aircraft configuration.
The 95% main-gear load split is a pavement-design assumption. Body meshes and strut attachments are illustrative, not engineering CAD.
Unknown and generic schematic aircraft do not receive substitute bodies.
$gearCodes: REMOVED in v1.9. This list was a third hand-maintained copy of the gear
code table — after src/core/schema.js and the app's own dropdown — and it
had already drifted out of the vocabulary FAA Order 5300.7 §6d requires.
Codes now come from src/core/gearcode.js, which derives them from the
naming convention itself, so there is one place for them to be wrong.
